text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts from inference-runtime (model-runner) in us-west-2. Error rate spike at 04:12 UTC. Pager triggered.

oncall-erin: Oncall here, looking. Any immediate customer impact metrics?

incident-bot: Current: 12.4% 5xx across gateway for /v1/generate over last 5m (baseline 0.1%). Top error: runtime crash / OOM / segfault. Autoscale is not recovering nodes fast enough.

eng-ryan: I'm attaching recent logs, looks like repeated c++ aborts in model-runner when kvcache expands. Seen OOM then SIGSEGV.

eng-ryan: ```
[2026-03-17T04:10:23Z] model-runner[pid:1223]: Alloc failed trying to grow kvcache: cannot allocate 134217728 bytes
[2026-03-17T04:10:27Z] model-runner[pid:1223]: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f9c4a1bf2ea sp 0x7ffd2ab3b9e8 error 4 in libattention.so
[2026-03-17T04:10:27Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 1223 (model-runner) total-vm:...
```

eng-kim: Confirmed on three nodes (gw-uw2-a/*). Sequence length distribution for requests spiked due to several large customer prompts >12k tokens, which bypassed our prefix cache heuristics. That kicked kvcache growth and memory pressure.

prod-ops: We're seeing node evictions and a burst of restarts. Autoscaler queued new nodes but warm-up is 90s+ so error window persists.

oncall-erin: Mitigation idea: 1) Rate-limit long-sequence requests at gateway for affected pool, 2) Route small/medium requests to fallback model-variant (quantized), 3) Evict pending massive requests to backlog. Can we toggle routing quickly?

eng-ryan: I can push a temporary routing policy to send sequences >4096 tokens to model-lite-quant in us-west-2. Doing a dry-run, then flip.

eng-kim: Also recommend disabling KV cache growth auto-resize on the hot pool to avoid runaway allocs. That will increase latency for long seqs but prevent OOM. I can prepare a hotpatch.

support-alex: Affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants (inc. redwood-ai-prod) seeing 40-60% errors. Several self-serve apps report degraded UX. Notifying CS for proactive outreach.

prod-ops: Routing policy PR submitted and staged for rollback window. ETA 2m to flip.

incident-bot: NOTE: Deploy window small: 60s safety hold after flip for rollback monitoring.

eng-ryan: Flipped routing now -> model-lite-quant for seq >4096. Monitor: 5xx dropped to 2.6% in 90s, tail latency slightly increased for routed traffic.

oncall-erin: Good. eng-kim can you apply the KV cache cap hotpatch? That will be risky but needed.

eng-kim: Applying hotpatch to the hot pool: set kvcache.max_size = 2GB and disable auto-grow. Rolling restart of model-runner containers with graceful drain. Starting batch of 3 nodes.

eng-kim: ```
-- hotpatch applied to gw-uw2-a:{node3,node7,node9}
setting kvcache.max_size=2147483648
disabled kvcache.auto_grow=true
waiting for drains...
```

prod-ops: Nodes restarted, evictions stopped. New pods healthy. Error rate trending down: 0.9% over last 5m.

support-alex: CS sent initial incident notice to redwood-ai-prod and two other tenants. Asking customers to switch to smaller prompt templates where possible.

eng-ryan: Post-mitigation notes: root cause likely interaction of large seq requests + kvcache auto-growth bug in attention kernel that miscalculates memory and leaks on grow-failure. Repro locally with stress harness.

eng-kim: For near-term: keep routing policy in place until we ship fix to attention kernel and add better pre-checks for sequence length in the gateway. Also add circuit-breaker for kvcache growth operations.

oncall-erin: Customer impact summary for incident bridge: 3 tenants impacted, peak 12% 5xx, mitigation reduced to <1% within ~12 minutes. No data loss reported. SLO hit for 10m window for those customers.

incident-bot: CREATED INCIDENT-2026-03-17-3311 (severity: high) - assigned: eng-runtime, eng-ml, prod-ops.

eng-ryan: I'll open a bug with triage checklist and attach repro, kernel stacktrace, and perf traces. Plan: patch attention kernel memory path + add runtime guard. Estimated fix ETA: 48-72 hours.

prod-ops: Suggest we also add an emergency routing rule template to Console so oncall can flip without eng PR next time. I'll own that.

oncall-erin: Thanks team. Keeping channel open for postmortem notes. I'll hand off to oncall shift change in 50m. :white_check_mark:

support-alex: I'll update customers with the mitigation summary and expected timeline for full fix.

eng-kim: Posting quick follow-up: we've left kvcache caps in place for the pool and kept routing policy active. Will revert when kernel patch is in and validated.

eng-ryan: Final note: capture core dumps and upload to secure bucket for root cause. Marking this thread for postmortem attachments.

oncall-erin: Closing live mitigation. Follow-up in #postmortems with RCA and timeline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT-2026-03-17-3311 moved to status: mitigated (monitored).
